# CARTRIDGE 4663

> An independent memecoin project on Robinhood Chain whose token is paired against the GME stock token. It is NOT GameStop stock and grants no shares, dividends, voting rights or ownership.

This site is a single long-form page. It presents a deliberately maximalist retro-arcade
theme over a small set of factual, independently verifiable claims about a token pairing.

## Key facts

- Network: Robinhood Chain mainnet, chain ID 4663 (0x1237)
- Quote asset: the GME stock token at 0x1b0E319c6A659F002271B69dB8A7df2F911c153E
  ("GameStop • Robinhood Token", symbol GME, 18 decimals) — issued by a third party, not by this project
- Launch venue: Pons V2 launch factory at 0x7eD598BcEf8bd9Edd8C97A195C6d13f40801EC7e
- Graduation threshold for a GME-quoted launch: 369 GME (read live from the factory)
- The project's own token is NOT DEPLOYED at the time of writing; the site renders a
  clearly-marked pre-launch state and shows NO SIGNAL for every unavailable metric.

## Important

- The project token is not a security and is not GameStop equity.
- This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by GameStop, Robinhood,
  Nintendo, or any other company referenced on the page.
- Prices shown describe a token pool. They are not official exchange quotes for GameStop shares.
- Nothing on the site is financial advice, and no return or outcome is promised.
